rows: Rothschild competitive advantage?
Information speed (private courier network) + capital network across 5 cities
Morgan's role in 1907 Panic?
Organized private lender-of-last-resort from his personal library; substituted for missing central bank
Gold standard adjustment mechanism?
Hume's price-specie flow: deficit country loses gold, prices fall, exports become cheaper, trade corrects
Why gold standard suppressed demand management?
Monetary policy subordinated to gold balance; cannot expand money supply to fight recessions
Long Depression cause?
Deflation (productivity grew faster than gold supply) + agricultural price collapse from US/Australian competition
Bryan's "Cross of Gold"?
Pro-silver bimetallism; inflation would help indebted farmers; opposed by eastern creditors and gold standard defenders
What was a "trust" legally?
Multiple companies' shareholders transferred shares to a board of trustees who managed all as one enterprise
Sherman Act initial enforcement?
Very weak 1890-1901; Standard Oil not broken up until 1911
Jekyll Island purpose?
Secret meeting to design central bank plan; hidden from populist opposition
What ended the first globalization?
WWI: capital flows reversed, gold standard suspended, trade collapsed
